Singular chains split as a direct sum over components, cochains and cohomology form the stated products in ZFC, and contravariance gives the left shift on both H0 and H1.

The quotient-induced cohomology arrow has the correct contravariant direction, the relative groups agree with reduced sphere cohomology, and the explicit n=1 diagonal-map cokernel calculation is complete.
The reduced Mayer-Vietoris connecting arrow has the correct direction and degree shift; the induction computes all sphere cohomology; and the n=1 intersection correctly uses reduced H0 of S0.
